title: Carrier Trace Results and the Refund Basis for Undelivered Parcels
content:
Carrier Relations note for Delivery Claims: on a Delivered Not Received or Lost in Transit Claim, the trace refund basis for the parcel's delivery charge follows the carrier trace result recorded on the claim.

**Rule.** The trace refund basis depends on the carrier trace result recorded on the claim: where the carrier confirmed the parcel lost (lost confirmed), the basis is the list fee of the order's delivery service plus the surcharge; where the carrier answered that it delivered the parcel (delivered confirmed), the basis is 50% of the fee paid plus the surcharge; in every other case the basis is the fee paid plus the surcharge.

- List fee: the fee of the order's delivery service in the Online Orders service schedule, before any waiver.
- Fee paid and surcharge: the effective shipping fee and the surcharge shown on the order.
- In the delivered confirmed case only the fee paid is halved; the surcharge is added in full.

| Carrier trace result on the claim | Trace refund basis |
|---|---|
| lost confirmed | list fee of the delivery service plus surcharge |
| delivered confirmed | 50% of the fee paid, plus surcharge |
| found in network, no response, or no trace result | fee paid plus surcharge |

## Worked figures (hypothetical order: list fee 14.00 USD, fee paid 6.00 USD, surcharge 2.00 USD)

| Trace result | Basis |
|---|---|
| lost confirmed | 14.00 plus 2.00 — 16.00 USD |
| delivered confirmed | 3.00 plus 2.00 — 5.00 USD |
| no response | 6.00 plus 2.00 — 8.00 USD |
